text:
maya: Heads-up — final cutoff in 3h. Quick rollout checklist: version bump, changelog nudge, green sweep, and flaky triage. Who's on sweep?

sam: I'm on green sweep. starting queue now. will post failures.

liz: I'll do changelog + small doc bump. ping me if any breaking notes.

maya: thx. can someone confirm binary compat check across mac/linux images? last time we had a stray build tag.

dinesh: I'll run compat shims. starting a shallow test matrix on mac-11 and ubuntu-22.

ci-bot: queued: release-green-sweep job #4821 started by sam. logs: https://ci.redwood.example/4821

sam: green sweep progress: 120/320 jobs done, ~1.7h ETA. seeing two flaky tests repeating: tests/inference/test_kv_cache.py::test_cache_eviction and tests/serving/test_timeout.py::test_stream_timeout

jen: noted. I've triaged test_stream_timeout recently — flake due to jittery timer in mock, PR with increased tolerance landed on main. is release pinned to older main?

sam: release branch pinned at main@f3a2b9 (before jen's fix). I can rebase if we want, but that might rip open other diffs.

maya: prefer not to rebase now unless it's a hard blocker. can we temporarily mark test as flaky in the run? add to CI skiplist for this sweep and follow up in postmortem.

dinesh: agree. adding explicit skip for that test:
```bash
python -m pytest -k "not test_stream_timeout"
```
will re-run the subset.

sam: done. re-run triggered. current green count up to 215/320. failing cluster now down to 4 unrelated flakes.

qa-bot: Heads-up: smoke e2e on canary env queued after green sweep completes. Expect ~20m for full pass.

liz: changelog draft updated. called out the runtime perf bump and the fallback routing tweak. leaving a TODO to add the KV-cache note.

maya: perfect. also: reminder to bump the package version to 2.4.1 in setup.cfg and release yaml. small checklist snippet:
- bump setup.cfg version
- update CHANGELOG.md entry (link to PRs)
- tag release branch
- trigger docker build job

sam: docker build queued once green. build id: docker-9072 (will post sha).

ci-bot: job docker-9072 started. base image: ubuntu-22, tag: release-2.4.1-candidate

sam: final: docker-9072 sha: sha256:8f7d... finished, smoke container boot OK.

maya: excellent. can we hold a 15-min post-cutoff stand once the release is cut to confirm metrics and alerting? 15:30 UTC?

liz: I can do 15:30. adding to calendar.

dinesh: I'll watch infra metrics and latency dashboards.

jen: I'll validate canary traces and fallback paths.

maya: thanks team. we'll reconvene if any critical flakes remain. otherwise, proceed with tagging in 30m. :thumbsup:
